summary.headline: Astrological Questions 71–89
summary.text: Continuation of an astrological question catalogue, entries 71–89, covering war, fugitives, marriage, an Indian nativity method, besieged cities, treasures, names, fortune, phlebotomy, thoughts, the cause and subject of questions, and whether the querent is prudent or foolish; citations include Codex Bononiensis 18 and Theophilus and Dorotheus. The next division begins with the nature and rulership of the stars.
